workflow_steps.title: Retrieve State College Census Tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain census tract polygon zones covering State College in a format supported by zonal statistics.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve a candidate census tract polygon dataset covering State College. Prefer GeoPackage format so it can be consumed directly by zonal_statistics. Use input_3 as the known State College spatial reference when evaluating coverage. Do not assume the retrieved candidate satisfies spatial coverage, polygon geometry, CRS, or format requirements until runtime inspection.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate Mean Elevation by Census Tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute mean elevation for each State College census tract using the 30-meter DEM.
workflow_steps.instructions:
Compute mean elevation for each polygon in census_tracts using input_2 as the selected elevation raster. Use the 30-meter raster because it meets the requested maximum resolution of 30 meters. Preserve tract-identifying attributes in the CSV output. Do not guess or hard-code runtime CRS, geometry, or schema details; validate them from runtime evidence and request clarification if consequential metadata remains unknown.
Recovery constraint: Reject the unsuitable candidate and retrieve another candidate satisfying the observed requirement.

requirements.scope: The retrieved census_tracts artifact must cover the State College area represented by input_3 and contain the requested census tract zones.
The census_tracts artifact must be available as a GeoPackage vector layer for zonal statistics.
The selected elevation raster must have pixel resolution no coarser than 30 meters.
The elevation raster and census tract zones must have compatible coordinate reference systems for zonal statistics.
The census_tracts artifact must contain valid, non-empty polygon geometries suitable for zonal statistics.
The elevation input must be a GeoTIFF raster and the zone input must be a GeoPackage polygon layer.
